import ctypes as c
from ctypes import wintypes as w
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json, os

k=c.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
k.CreateFileW.argtypes=[w.LPCWSTR,w.DWORD,w.DWORD,c.c_void_p,w.DWORD,w.DWORD,w.HANDLE]
k.CreateFileW.restype=w.HANDLE
k.CloseHandle.argtypes=[w.HANDLE]
k.ReadFile.argtypes=[w.HANDLE,c.c_void_p,w.DWORD,c.POINTER(w.DWORD),c.c_void_p]
k.GetFileSizeEx.argtypes=[w.HANDLE,c.POINTER(c.c_longlong)]
k.GetFileInformationByHandleEx.argtypes=[w.HANDLE,c.c_int,c.c_void_p,w.DWORD]
k.SetFileInformationByHandle.argtypes=[w.HANDLE,c.c_int,c.c_void_p,w.DWORD]
class NativeId(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[('volume',c.c_ulonglong),('file',c.c_ubyte*16)]
def check(value):
    if not value:raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
def opened(path,access,flags,share):
    handle=k.CreateFileW(str(path),access,share,None,3,flags,None)
    if handle==c.c_void_p(-1).value:raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
    return handle
root=Path(os.environ['TEMP'])/'voldiq-admission-uSFzHQ'
assert root.parent.resolve()==Path(os.environ['TEMP']).resolve()
parent=opened(root,0x80,0x2300000,3)
try:
    root_attributes=(w.DWORD*2)()
    check(k.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(parent,9,root_attributes,c.sizeof(root_attributes)))
    assert root_attributes[0]&0x10 and not root_attributes[0]&0x400
    assert not root.is_symlink() and {p.name for p in root.iterdir()}=={'owned.bin'}
    source=opened(root/'owned.bin',0x10081,0x300000,1)
    try:
        attributes=(w.DWORD*2)()
        check(k.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(source,9,attributes,c.sizeof(attributes)))
        assert not attributes[0] & (0x10|0x400|0x1000|0x40000|0x400000)
        length=c.c_longlong(); check(k.GetFileSizeEx(source,c.byref(length))); assert length.value==4
        content=c.create_string_buffer(4); count=w.DWORD()
        check(k.ReadFile(source,content,4,c.byref(count),None));assert count.value==4 and content.raw==bytes([1,2,3,4])
        identity=NativeId();check(k.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(source,18,c.byref(identity),c.sizeof(identity)))
        delete=c.c_ubyte(1);check(k.SetFileInformationByHandle(source,4,c.byref(delete),1))
    finally:k.CloseHandle(source)
finally:k.CloseHandle(parent)
os.rmdir(root)
report={'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'fixture':str(root),'scope':'Only the reserved own fixture retained before parent capability acquisition. No journal or stage had been created. The exact four-byte payload was verified and removed through the same retained source handle; the root was removed nonrecursively.','sourceVolume':identity.volume,'sourceFileId':bytes(identity.file).hex(),'ownedFixtureCleaned':True,'script':Path(__file__).read_text()}
output=Path('benchmarks')/('parent-capability-probe-cleanup-'+datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')+'.json')
with output.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as file:json.dump(report,file,indent=2);file.write('\n')
